# Third-party materials

This archive references vendor toolchains, Nordic SDKs, TI driverlib, ESP-IDF,
and component datasheets. Their licenses and download terms remain with their
respective vendors. Installers, SDK archives, and the unrelated
`commercial_fpga_reference` payload were not copied into this repository.

The firmware source folders retain the notices shipped by the upstream WULPUS
repositories. Before redistributing a binary, verify the SDK license and keep
the corresponding notice files with the binary.
